Add support to process factory test mode commands (FTM) for calibration.
By default firmware start with NORMAL mode and to process the FTM commands
firmware needs to be restarted in FTM mode using module parameter ftm_mode.
The pre-request is all the radios should be down before starting the test.
When start command ATH11K_TM_CMD_TESTMODE_START is received
is set to Test Mode. If the FTM command or event length is greater
than 256 bytes
column2: it will be broken down into multiple segments and

column1: encoded with TLV header if it is segmented commands
to firmware as it is.
On receiving UTF event from firmware
will wait until it receives all the segments and notify the complete
data to user application. In case the segmented sequence are missed or
lost from the firmware
column2: driver will skip the already received partial data.

column1: In case of unsegmented UTF event from firmware
data to the user application as it comes. Applications handles
the data further.
